styles.terse: as short as possible, like a search box - drop articles and auxiliary verbs
styles.colloquial: how a first-time retail investor would actually say it out loud, casually
styles.verbose: a full rambling sentence with a clause of context before the question
styles.jargon: using fund-industry jargon and abbreviations, the way an analyst would
styles.keywords: just the keywords, no grammatical sentence at all, like a query string
